notes.title: October 2024 Update!
notes.content:
I’m back!

I recently took a needed break, but now I’m back working full time on Cairn: Mathair’s Curse, and I’d like to share what’s happening now with development.

I’m working on the last incomplete chapter of the game. To give an idea, there are 14 chapters in the game. If you’ve played the demo, the demo is about half of chapter 1. Not all the chapters are quite as hefty as chapter 1, but it gives an idea of what to expect for the full game! 

My testers have been testing the rest of the game bar the chapter I am working on. After I finish developing this chapter, I will be doing the bug fixing and tweaks from the testing and implementing music that has been written for the game.

My partner has been writing new music for the whole game. So far, she has written over 80 tracks for the game and still more to go!

It’s very exciting to see everything coming together after these years of development. 

Lastly, I’ll share this very cute hoodie my partner hand-embroidered Alex on as a gift to me recently. If you’re local to the Dundee area in Scotland, I’ll be wearing this at the DCA Drop and Play event on 12th October 2024, which is a family friendly event, where people can try out indie games and meet their developers. If that sounds of interest, come and say hi! 

Dundee DCA Drop in and Play Event: [url=https://www.dca.org.uk/events/oXi-drop-in-and-play/]https://www.dca.org.uk/events/oXi-drop-in-and-play/[/url]

notes.title: A Developer and Development Update
notes.content:
I'd like to share an update on the release of Cairn: Mathair's Curse. 

Recently, I've had some health issues meaning I've been unable to work on the game, as I needed a break to recover. 

Thankfully, I'm getting better but I've decided to delay the game's release. It's really important to me that the game is complete and as polished as possible when it's released. 

Thanks to everyone who is excited and has left encouraging words over the past few months and years, it means a lot! I'll be able to set a new release date once I'm fully recovered and back in full swing.

notes.title: Demo updated, thank you for playing!
notes.content:
It's been a week since we released the Cairn: Mathair's Curse demo and I'm very happy to hear people are enjoying the demo - it is beyond encouraging, so thank you for giving it a go if you have!

We also received some kind constructive comments so we've made some updates to the demo build.

[list]
[*]Combat re-balancing. The demo-only area allowed higher levels and more XP to grind, and I underestimated how easy the final fight would be in the demo! I've made the demo enemies a fair bit tougher 
[*]Bug fix that hopefully fixes a screen freeze on Steam deck
[*]Some extra signposting to lead the way around Awnie Island
[*]Dialogue's with choices now allow multiple choices to be viewed before ending the scene
[*]Robin's now allow you to view controls 
[*]Controller binds now offer an extra action button and page changes in menus are switched to trigger buttons
[*]Fixed a defeat screen crash when no saves are present
[/list]

Anymore more changes I will make for the full game for release, and not in the demo, so they'll still be new things to discover on release!

notes.title: Mother Direct 2023, Game Updates & More!
notes.content:
We’re extremely excited to be taking part in the Mother Direct 2023 later this month, where we will be sharing a new exclusive trailer - featuring new gameplay, locations, enemies, soundtrack and more! Be sure to tune in on the 27th of July on the Mother Forever youtube channel:

[previewyoutube=Agjb4PwfNn0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Recent Game Updates
[/h2]
•	Recently, we have begun having our group of testers go through the starting chapters of the game, primarily ironing out any bugs and gameplay tweeks. Their insight has been absolutely invaluable - so thank you to all our testers!
•	All enemies in the game are now animated - this stop sign looks WAY more dangerous!
•	In-game transit system, to easily bring your party from A to B and back again!
•	An upgrade-able house location, restore an abandoned mansion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37855620/2d6b9cc973c518f8870691dbe9b663a0f3411d1e.gif[/img]


Many updates to the game will be shown in the Mother Direct 2023 – so make sure you tune in to see Cairn, and all the other brilliant Mother fan-projects, indie games and more! We have been working hard on the game all year, so it's really exciting to be showing all the new content.

notes.title: Game update August 2022!
notes.content:
Hello! We would like to bring a developer update on Cairn: Mathair's Curse to let you know about the progress to the game since the demo launch! 

Thank you to everyone who gave the demo a go! The feedback we received was really helpful.

Some notable changes since demo’s release:

[list]
[*] Battle mechanics have been significantly reworked, as well as improvements to the artwork and battlescreens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37855620/c4be8fa78d7f8a90775f01e05d456f1288c91795.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37855620/3de1a884a7e2b0d283df2c76c8d37af624167c95.gif[/img]
[*] New weather, cinematic and particle systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37855620/93ff1e93061afa03e7b64e556f73c62df1468145.gif[/img]

[*] Quest log system, and UI updates.
[*] Lots of whacky new events, characters and scenes.
[*] Requested feature of character portraits for important characters.
[*] New damage text for battles.
[*] New interactables and better doors (woo!)
[/list]

We will be releasing a new trailer soon to showcase major updates and to show you more of the game!
